about.title: A Leiden institution since 1938
about.text: Schaap's Vishandel has been on Herenstraat in Leiden since 1938. Four generations of craftsmanship, honest fish and a personal story. Aldert Haasnoot — known in the neighbourhood simply as 'Schaap' — is ready every day to help you.

verhaalPage.heroTitle: From Gerrit Schaap to the fourth generation
verhaalPage.intro: For almost ninety years, a small, cosy fish shop on Herenstraat in Leiden has fed, delighted and connected generations of Leiden residents. Schaap's Vishandel is not just a shop — it is a piece of Leiden history.
verhaalPage.t1text: Gerrit Schaap opens his fish shop at Herenstraat 48 in Leiden. At a time when fish truly came fresh from the boat and every Leiden resident had their own fishmonger, Gerrit lays the foundation for what would grow into a city institution.
verhaalPage.t2text: Young Cor Haasnoot starts working for Mr Schaap at just thirteen years old. He learns the trade from the ground up and takes over the business in 1957. The name 'Schaap' stays — a tribute to the founder who has become inseparably linked to the shop.
verhaalPage.t3text: Aldert Haasnoot — known simply as 'Schaap' in the neighbourhood — has stood behind the counter his entire life. In 2009 he officially takes over from his father, bringing the shop into the 21st century while preserving the atmosphere Leiden residents cherish: personal, warm, honest.
verhaalPage.t3quote: People come here not just for the fish, but for the conversation. Sometimes it's like a village pub in here. — Aldert Haasnoot
verhaalPage.t4text: On 1 January 2018, Schaap's Vis turns 80. The whole city celebrates. Customers send in photos and memories for an anniversary book. One of the most charming: Ria Verburg, who collected kibbeling monthly for the nursery and always came back for Mr Schaap's joke.
verhaalPage.t4quote: When picking up he always said: 'a box of kibbeling for the orphanage!' It always made me laugh. — Ria Verburg
verhaalPage.t5title: Today — ready for the next generation
verhaalPage.t5text: Schaap's Vis is preparing for its fourth generation. Alongside the shop on Herenstraat, the team now also appears at the Leiden market (Wednesday and Saturday) and at Hoogvliet in Voorschoten on Fridays. The range has grown — but the warmth has remained.
verhaalPage.outroQuote: We are a lovely old little shop. Not everything has to be brand new and spick and span.

varlaksPage.heroTitle: Varlaks — organic salmon from the Arctic waters of Norway
varlaksPage.heroSub: Free from antibiotics, hormones and GMO. Pure nature — you can taste it.
varlaksPage.story: We already had a good range. But when we discovered Varlaks, we knew this was something different. Not a large company, not an anonymous farm — but small-scale family farms above the Arctic Circle in Norway, where the salmon simply have the space to grow. Slowly, in clean water, without shortcuts. You can taste it. The texture is firmer, the flavour purer. No additives to mask the taste — because there simply aren't any. We are proud to offer this at Schaap's Vis. Come and taste the difference.
varlaksPage.f1text: The salmon grow in the ice-cold, oxygen-rich waters of northern Norway. The current of cold mountain water keeps the water pure and clean — ideal conditions for salmon that grow slowly and naturally.
varlaksPage.f2text: Varlaks works exclusively with carefully selected family businesses. Farms are visited personally each year to guarantee quality and sustainability. From egg to end product — fully traceable.
varlaksPage.f3title: No antibiotics, no GMO, no hormones
varlaksPage.f3text: Thanks to low stocking density and the pure environment, antibiotics simply have no place in this farming concept. The salmon grow with natural feed, plenty of space and no chemical additives.
varlaksPage.f4text: From the farm in Norway to your plate: every piece of Varlaks salmon is fully traceable. You know exactly what you're eating and where it comes from.
varlaksPage.ctaText: Varlaks salmon is available daily in our shop on Herenstraat, at the Leiden market (Wednesday & Saturday) and at Hoogvliet Voorschoten on Friday.

eerlijkeVisPage.heroSub: Organic Varlaks salmon, MSC- and ASC-certified fish. Sustainable, honest and transparent — even when the story isn't perfect.
eerlijkeVisPage.whyText1: At Schaap's Vis it's not just about fresh and delicious — it's also about how the fish got to your plate. We consciously work with suppliers who put transparency, animal welfare and sustainability first.
eerlijkeVisPage.whyText2: That means traceable fish. Fish caught or farmed with respect for the sea. Fish where you know what's in it — and what isn't.
eerlijkeVisPage.cert1desc: Marine Stewardship Council — the international label for sustainable wild fisheries. Fishermen don't catch more than the sea can handle.
eerlijkeVisPage.cert2desc: Aquaculture Stewardship Council — the label for responsible farmed fish. Less environmental impact, better conditions for the fish.
eerlijkeVisPage.cert3desc: No antibiotics, no hormones, no genetically modified ingredients. Pure nature — as it was meant to be.
eerlijkeVisPage.cert4desc: From sea to counter. You can trace the origin of every fish we sell — we are transparent about every product in our range.
eerlijkeVisPage.varlaksText: The most special fish in our range is the Varlaks organic salmon. Raised by family farmers above the Arctic Circle in Norway, without antibiotics or GMO, in the coldest and cleanest water in the world. No shortcuts, no surprises.
eerlijkeVisPage.listSub: Below you will find all the fish we have consciously selected — each with its own story.
eerlijkeVisPage.comingSoonText: We are compiling the full list of all our sustainable fish — from MSC-certified cod to organic trout. Come back for the full overview, or visit us in the shop.
eerlijkeVisPage.ctaText: Not sure which fish is the best choice? We are happy to help — every day in the shop at Herenstraat 48, Leiden.
